question: next_command
instructions: Which command should be sent to the harness next? Use the current state and the last turn. Prefer a common transition. Choose other when the harness is waiting on a person, or when the right next line is not one of the listed commands.

commands.intend: intend <goal>. Open a DAG. The default next state is steered, via steer.
commands.intend_ask: intend --ask <goal>. Present the DAG and stop for the person.
commands.steer: steer. Decision briefing, then menus. Recommended first, skip always available.
commands.change: change <id>. Scaffold the change from steer residue. Do not implement.
commands.advise: advise <id>. Spawn a fresh other-family reader. Wait for accept or send-back.
commands.activate: activate this set. Record the grant, prepare contracts, and pause.
commands.activate_and_run: activate and run. Record the grant and continue the campaign.
commands.run: run. Conduct the next ready wave.
commands.demo: demo <id>. Walk the landed journey, then stop.
commands.fold: fold <id>. Merge the change into living specs and archive it.
commands.brief: brief. Write one disposable unit of work.
commands.debrief: debrief. Record takeaways from the unit that just finished.
commands.consult: consult. Ask for a second opinion. This does not change the DAG.
commands.spike: Run the open spike and stop when it has a verdict.
commands.answer: Answer what the harness just asked. Do not send a stock campaign command.
commands.status: status. Read the board and do not implement.
commands.map: map. Reprint this DAG and do not implement.
commands.other: A free instruction. The harness can be told anything. Use this when it is asking, or when none of the common transitions fit.

intended.means: A DAG exists and steer has not been answered.

scaffolded.means: The change directory exists and implementation is not authorized yet.

advising.means: A reader is owed or still reading.

accepted.means: The last counted advise verdict is accept, and act is legal.

ready.means: A node can be implemented or the campaign can take another wave.

eyes.means: The campaign halted for a human look. YOUR EYES is still open.

ask.means: The harness asked for a decision, a verdict, or a direction.

landed.means: An act committed and the change is not archived.

campaign.means: A grant is recorded and the last turn continued the campaign without asking.

folded.means: The change is archived into living specs.
